Hi Elena,

Thanks again for taking the time on Friday. We're starting the vendor onboarding for Aurora Component Manufacturing so finance and procurement can route purchase orders to the right accounts. To complete the "vendor master" in our system we need the following items from you:

1) Legal entity name exactly as it should appear on invoices (including d/b/a if applicable)
2) Registered business address (street, city, state, ZIP) and country
3) Tax identifier (EIN or local VAT/GST if outside US) and tax classification
4) Primary AP contact for invoices (name, email, phone) and a secondary contact for escalation
5) Bank remittance details or ACH instructions (bank name, account name, routing/IBAN) — we can accept a bank letter if you prefer not to put account numbers in email
6) A copy of W9 (or W8-BEN if applicable) and any regulatory docs relevant to cross-border payments

If you can send the documents and answers today or tomorrow we can generate the PO template and approve your vendor record in time for our first replenishment order next week.

I'll loop in Finance (Kimberly) and Procurement (Karthik) to speed up verification. Let me know if your AP team prefers a secure upload link versus email attachments.

Best,
Diego
Head of Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: onboarding-checklist.csv (CSV, 3 KB)]
